Definition: Whether consumer protection legislation or regulations specifically address digital payment services, covering disclosure requirements, liability allocation for unauthorized transactions, error resolution procedures, and user rights.
Comments: Angola enacted a comprehensive Consumer Protection Law — Law No. 15/03 of 22 July 2003 (Lei de Defesa do Consumidor). This law establishes consumer rights including quality of goods and services, economic protection, right to information, and redress mechanisms. It covers financial services and electronic payments. The law establishes administrative sanctions including fines, suspension of services, and other remedies. This is a full consumer protection legal framework applicable to payment services.
